dialogues.en: "...Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "...Shall we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の唐突な呟きに、びっくりした猫のような顔
を向けてくる。
dialogues.en:
I abruptly muttered under my breath, and Kotori looked a bit
like a surprised cat.
dialogues.text:
I abruptly muttered under my breath, and Kotori looked a bit
like a surprised cat.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……行くって、どこに行くんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go, to where?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go, to where?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どこだろうな……」
dialogues.en: "Anywhere..."
dialogues.text: "Anywhere..."

dialogues.jp: 遠い目をしてみる。
dialogues.en: My eyes gazed far into the distant.
dialogues.text: My eyes gazed far into the distant.

dialogues.jp: 「ここじゃないどこかさ」
dialogues.en: "As long as it isn't here."
dialogues.text: "As long as it isn't here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「春、ですもんね……」
dialogues.en: "It's spring, isn't it..."
dialogues.text: "It's spring, isn't it..."

dialogues.jp:
なにかものすごい慈愛に満ちた眼差しで見つめ
られつつ、しみじみと呟かれるのは……どうい
う意味だろうなぁ。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, she looked at me with eyes that felt
affectionate, as she said those words... what did she mean
by them?
dialogues.text:
For some reason, she looked at me with eyes that felt
affectionate, as she said those words... what did she mean
by them?

dialogues.jp:
深く考えるのはやめよう。答えはきっと、知ら
ない方がいいに違いない。
dialogues.en:
I better not think about it too deeply. It'd surely be
better if I didn't know the answer.
dialogues.text:
I better not think about it too deeply. It'd surely be
better if I didn't know the answer.

dialogues.jp:
「そう言えばことり、帰ったんじゃなかったっ
　け？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway Kotori, I thought you went home already?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway Kotori, I thought you went home already?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「友達を呼びにこの教室に来たって……今さっ
　き言いませんでしたっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"My friends called me to come to this classroom... did you
hear anything about that?"
dialogues.text:
"My friends called me to come to this classroom... did you
hear anything about that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そんな気もする」
dialogues.en: "Well, I think I remember something like that."
dialogues.text: "Well, I think I remember something like that."

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど空で軽い鞄を肩に掛け、椅子から立ち
上がる。
dialogues.en:
I quietly put my bag on my shoulder, and stood up from my
chair.
dialogues.text:
I quietly put my bag on my shoulder, and stood up from my
chair.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、見ての通り誰も居ないぜ？」
dialogues.en: "But as you can see, no one's around."
dialogues.text: "But as you can see, no one's around."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「みんな帰っているのに、何で朝倉君だけ一人
　ぼんやりと座ってたんですか？　初め、何か
　と思ってびっくりしちゃいましたよ」
dialogues.en:
"Everyone's left already, why were you still sitting here?
I've never seen you do that before, so you frightened me a
bit."
dialogues.text:
"Everyone's left already, why were you still sitting here?
I've never seen you do that before, so you frightened me a
bit."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「寝てたんだ。薄情なクラスの連中は、俺を放
　置プレイにしたって事だな」
dialogues.en:
"I was sleeping. And apparently my classmates were cruel
enough to leave me here till I woke up."
dialogues.text:
"I was sleeping. And apparently my classmates were cruel
enough to leave me here till I woke up."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「余程ぐっすり眠ってたんですね」
dialogues.en: "It must've been a really deep sleep."
dialogues.text: "It must've been a really deep sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「のぶ太くんのようにか」
dialogues.en: "Couldn't have been more than Nobuta-kun."
dialogues.text: "Couldn't have been more than Nobuta-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「誰ですか、それは……」
dialogues.en: "Who's that..."
dialogues.text: "Who's that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「誰だろうなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I wonder..."
dialogues.text: "I wonder..."

dialogues.jp: しみじみと呟く。
dialogues.en: I earnestly muttered.
dialogues.text: I earnestly muttered.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「自分で言って、しみじみと呟かないでくださ
　い」
dialogues.en:
"You said it yourself, you really should explain it, you
know."
dialogues.text:
"You said it yourself, you really should explain it, you
know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、それはそれとして、だ。ことりの薄情
　な友達はどうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's nothing anyway. What happened to your own cruel
friends?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's nothing anyway. What happened to your own cruel
friends?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「薄情なんかじゃありませんよ。入れ違いになっ
　ちゃったんですね、きっと」
dialogues.en:
"They're not cruel. We must've just missed each other on the
way, I'm sure."
dialogues.text:
"They're not cruel. We must've just missed each other on the
way, I'm sure."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、音楽室で先に待ってると思います」
dialogues.en: "I guess they're probably waiting at the music room."
dialogues.text: "I guess they're probably waiting at the music room."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「音楽室？　何で？」
dialogues.en: "Music room? Why?"
dialogues.text: "Music room? Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「卒業パーティーの練習で集まるんですよ。も
　う、迫ってきましたからね」
dialogues.en:
"We're meeting to practice for the graduation party. It's
getting closer and closer, you know."
dialogues.text:
"We're meeting to practice for the graduation party. It's
getting closer and closer, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、卒パな」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, the graduation party."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, the graduation party."

dialogues.jp:
近頃、それに関連して、どうも学園の中があわ
ただしい。杉並とか。杉並とか。杉並とか……。
dialogues.en:
Recently, lots of people have become involved in that thing.
Like Suginami. And Suginami. Not to mention Suginami...
dialogues.text:
Recently, lots of people have become involved in that thing.
Like Suginami. And Suginami. Not to mention Suginami...

dialogues.jp:
「音楽室って事は、やっぱ、音楽に関連した事
　をやるの？」
dialogues.en:
"If you're meeting at the music room, then I guess you guys
would be doing something related to music?"
dialogues.text:
"If you're meeting at the music room, then I guess you guys
would be doing something related to music?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。みんなで曲を演奏するんです。私が、
　ボーカルを取るんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. We'd be putting on a musical performance. I'd be
handling the vocal parts.
dialogues.text:
"Yes. We'd be putting on a musical performance. I'd be
handling the vocal parts.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "He-eh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eh..."

dialogues.jp:
思わず想像してしまう。｛だんじょう／壇上｝に立ち、マイクの
前でその美声を披露することり。
dialogues.en:
I could see it in my imagination. Kotori, standing on a
platform with a microphone, a beautiful voice emnating from
that mouth and reverberating throughout the room.
dialogues.text:
I could see it in my imagination. Kotori, standing on a
platform with a microphone, a beautiful voice emnating from
that mouth and reverberating throughout the room.

dialogues.jp: ……いいかも。
dialogues.en: ...That would be amazing.
dialogues.text: ...That would be amazing.

dialogues.jp:
何か、ことりの学内人気がますますうなぎ登りっ
て感じだよな。
dialogues.en:
It would surely raise Kotori's standing in the school even
further than it is now.
dialogues.text:
It would surely raise Kotori's standing in the school even
further than it is now.

dialogues.jp: ……ちょっと、心配かも。
dialogues.en: ...And that worries me a little.
dialogues.text: ...And that worries me a little.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え、に、人気なんて上がりませんよー。ボー
　カルが主役って訳でもないし……」
dialogues.en:
"Eh, I, I won't become more popular just from that~. The
vocals aren't that important to a song..."
dialogues.text:
"Eh, I, I won't become more popular just from that~. The
vocals aren't that important to a song..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うぃ！？　俺、口に出してた？　今」
dialogues.en: "Whaa? Did I just say that?"
dialogues.text: "Whaa? Did I just say that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、あーあー、え〜と……」
dialogues.en: "Eeeeeh? A, ah, ahh.... uhmmm..."
dialogues.text: "Eeeeeh? A, ah, ahh.... uhmmm..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。ぶつぶつと。私、チリバツで聞いちゃ
　いました」
dialogues.en:
"Y, yeah, you were muttering in a barely audible voice. But
I have good ears!"
dialogues.text:
"Y, yeah, you were muttering in a barely audible voice. But
I have good ears!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「チリバツって……」
dialogues.en: "Good ears, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Good ears, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
何時代の言語だ。ことりはことりで、あたふた
しているみたいだが……。
dialogues.en: She seems much more excitable than usual... well, whatever.
dialogues.text: She seems much more excitable than usual... well, whatever.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、今度から気をつけよう。独り言は、みっ
　ともないからな」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry for that then... I probably said something a bit
indecent."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry for that then... I probably said something a bit
indecent."

dialogues.jp:
「で、どんな曲やるんだ？　もしや、オリジナ
　ル？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what kind of song will you be performing? An
original?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what kind of song will you be performing? An
original?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いえ。作曲はみんな無理なので、コピーです。
　耳コピですけどね」
dialogues.en:
"No. An original would be too much for everyone.. we're
doing a cover."
dialogues.text:
"No. An original would be too much for everyone.. we're
doing a cover."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「｛フィリア／ＦＩＧＬＩＡ｝っていう、ふっる〜いイタリア
　のバンドの曲です」
dialogues.en:
"It's called "FIGLIA", it's a reaaaaaaally old song from an
Italian band."
dialogues.text:
"It's called "FIGLIA", it's a reaaaaaaally old song from an
Italian band."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……古いイタリア？　何か、マイナーそうだ
　な」
dialogues.en: "...Old and Italian? Guess they're not very big."
dialogues.text: "...Old and Italian? Guess they're not very big."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうかもしれないですね。ほとんどの人は知
　らないかも。趣味で選んじゃったんで」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know about that. We don't know everything about
people, and definitely not their tastes."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know about that. We don't know everything about
people, and definitely not their tastes."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でもでも、曲はいいんで、聴いたらみんな、
　“おお”って思ってくれますよ」
dialogues.en:
"But, I think it's really good, and if people heard it,
they'd be all "Oooooooh" over it."
dialogues.text:
"But, I think it's really good, and if people heard it,
they'd be all "Oooooooh" over it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おお」
dialogues.en: "Oooooooh."
dialogues.text: "Oooooooh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「聴いてからにしてくださいよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Save that for when you actually hear it~"
dialogues.text: "Save that for when you actually hear it~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、先行体験版だ。ともかく、楽しみにして
　る」
dialogues.en:
"Just preparing myself first. Both ways, I bet it'd be
great."
dialogues.text:
"Just preparing myself first. Both ways, I bet it'd be
great."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい。絶対見に来てくださいね」
dialogues.en: "It will. Make sure you come and see it!"
dialogues.text: "It will. Make sure you come and see it!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「練習を始めたのは２、３日前からですけど、
　卒業パーティーには絶対間に合わせますから」
dialogues.en:
"We started practicing 2 or 3 days ago, so we should be just
about ready by the time the graduation party rolls around."
dialogues.text:
"We started practicing 2 or 3 days ago, so we should be just
about ready by the time the graduation party rolls around."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あと１０日もないもんな」
dialogues.en: "That's about 10 days left."
dialogues.text: "That's about 10 days left."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「友達はふたりとも上手いですからね。きっと、
　大丈夫です」
dialogues.en: "My friends are really skilled, I'm sure it'd be alright."
dialogues.text: "My friends are really skilled, I'm sure it'd be alright."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことりも入れて３人なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "You'd be performing in a group of three?"
dialogues.text: "You'd be performing in a group of three?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「で、その上手い友達に挟まれたことりは？」
dialogues.en:
"Then, you're like the person the two skilled ones are
trying to catch up to?"
dialogues.text:
"Then, you're like the person the two skilled ones are
trying to catch up to?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……実は、私が一番不安要因なんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Actually, I'm more worried about myself than anyone
else."
dialogues.text:
"...Actually, I'm more worried about myself than anyone
else."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そおか？　そんな事はないと思うけどな」
dialogues.en: "Really? I don't see any cause for concern for that."
dialogues.text: "Really? I don't see any cause for concern for that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「練習の時間が……ちょっと。１日は、私のわ
　がままで、練習を空けるし……」
dialogues.en:
"My practice time is... shorter. Especially since one day,
I'd be taking off for my own selfish reasons..."
dialogues.text:
"My practice time is... shorter. Especially since one day,
I'd be taking off for my own selfish reasons..."

dialogues.jp:
気弱な笑顔を浮かべる。俺はわざと、陽気な笑
顔を浮かべてみせた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori gave me a weak smile. It was one that didn't suit her
face at all.
dialogues.text:
Kotori gave me a weak smile. It was one that didn't suit her
face at all.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、ま、ことりの歌だったら、泣く子も黙
　るだろ。平気だって」
dialogues.en:
"But, well, your song could make even crying babies calm
down."
dialogues.text:
"But, well, your song could make even crying babies calm
down."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「泣く子も黙るって……｛ほ／誉｝めてませんよ、それ」
dialogues.en: "Calm down crying babies... don't flatter me like that."
dialogues.text: "Calm down crying babies... don't flatter me like that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「誉めてないからな」
dialogues.en: "It's not flattery."
dialogues.text: "It's not flattery."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いいですよーだ。当日の演奏を見て、驚かな
　いでくださいよっ」
dialogues.en:
"Fiiiine. Just don't be surprised when you actually hear the
performance."
dialogues.text:
"Fiiiine. Just don't be surprised when you actually hear the
performance."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、楽しみにしてるよ」
dialogues.en: "It'd be great."
dialogues.text: "It'd be great."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
一転して笑顔を浮かべると、ことりはすっと後
ろに下がった。
dialogues.en:
The more familiar smile returned to her face, and she bowed
down slightly.
dialogues.text:
The more familiar smile returned to her face, and she bowed
down slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、あんまりぐずぐずしていると、友
　達に怒られちゃうので、これにて失礼します」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, if I stay here too long to chit-chat, my friends
will get angry with me, so I better get going."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, if I stay here too long to chit-chat, my friends
will get angry with me, so I better get going."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあね、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "See you later, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "See you later, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ」
dialogues.en: "Later."
dialogues.text: "Later."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、とてとてと小走りに、教室を出ていっ
た。
dialogues.en: Kotori took light steps out of the classroom.
dialogues.text: Kotori took light steps out of the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、俺も帰るか」
dialogues.en: "Guess I'd go home as well."
dialogues.text: "Guess I'd go home as well."

dialogues.jp:
ことりと一緒に帰る事は出来なかったけれど、
まあ、良しとしよう。
dialogues.en:
Looks like I won't be able to go home together with her, but
oh well.
dialogues.text:
Looks like I won't be able to go home together with her, but
oh well.

dialogues.jp: ◆卒業パーティーにことりは◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Graduation Party Preparations◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Graduation Party Preparations◆

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ卒業パーティーの季節。ことりはなん
と、友達と一緒に曲の生演奏をするらしい。
dialogues.en:
The graduation party was approaching quickly. Kotori was
planning to do a musical performance with her friends.
dialogues.text:
The graduation party was approaching quickly. Kotori was
planning to do a musical performance with her friends.

dialogues.jp: ことりの歌声。ちょっと、楽しみ。
dialogues.en: Kotori singing... that'd definitely be a joy to listen to.
dialogues.text: Kotori singing... that'd definitely be a joy to listen to.
